sentences.en: A big crowd gathered at the scene of the fire.
sentences.zh: 一大群人在火灾现场聚集。

sentences.en: The scene of the murder was too terrible to describe.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案现场太可怕了，无法描述。

sentences.en: Five fire engines rushed to the scene of the fire.
sentences.zh: 五辆消防车迅速赶往火灾现场。

senses.zh: 场景，景象；舞台，布景；事件，情景；场面，镜头；圈子，界，领域
